mechanism: Both drugs can cause hyperuricemia and hepatotoxicity; zidovudine may inhibit pyrazinamide metabolism via competition for renal tubular secretion, potentially increasing pyrazinamide levels.
action: Monitor serum uric acid levels, liver function tests, and clinical symptoms of gout or hepatotoxicity; consider alternative TB regimen if possible, especially in patients with baseline hyperuricemia or hepatic impairment.
